energy_bookkeeping: For an electron-attachment energy, define charge states, spin states, geometry and energy components. Under the conventional positive-affinity sign, EA=E(neutral)-E(anion), with the free electron as the common zero; other conventions require an explicit conversion.
geometry_and_corrections: State whether a reported quantity is electronic, vibrationally corrected, vertical, adiabatic, constrained or otherwise defined. These definitions describe your selected observable; they are not a requirement to compute every category.
state_evidence: Stationary-point, minimum or lowest-state claims require evidence appropriate to that claim and search domain. A constrained stationary point is not a free minimum. Electronic convergence alone does not establish state stability or a valid minimum.
electronic_interpretation: Supply reproducible quantities and raw evidence for the electronic interpretation actually claimed. Different scientifically justified representations or analyses are allowed; no population partition or orbital analysis is prescribed.
scope: Negative or unresolved conclusions need affirmative evidence at the declared resolution. Missing endpoints and failed calculations instead limit completion and must be reported honestly.
